title: ‘बाँझो जग्गामा फूल फुलाएर आत्मनिर्भर बन्दै तिलोत्तमाका महिला’ (भिडिओ)

No ads found for this position रुपन्देही । रुपन्देहीको तिलोत्तमा नगरपालिका वडा नं ४ डिंगरनगरका स्थानीय महिलाको सक्रियताले खाली रहेको जग्गालाई आम्दानीको स्रोतमा परिणत गरिएको छ। स्थानीयले समूह बनाएर यसरी खाली रहेको जग्गालाई मौसमी तरकारी तथा फूलखेती गरेर आधुनिक व्यवसायिक केन्द्र बनाएका हुन् । केही वर्षअघिसम्म व्यक्तिको जग्गा भएपनि कुनै उत्पादनमूलक क्षेत्रमा नरहेको तर अहिले समूहमार्फत त्यसको सदुपयोग गरेर यस्तो उत्पादनमूलक क्षेत्रमा परिणत गरेका हुन् । त्यसो त उनीहरुको योजनामा त्यहाँको नगरपालिका आधारित कृषि विकास कार्यक्रम अन्तर्गत स्थानीय महिलाहरुको सकृयतामा पुरुषहरुसमेत मिलेर क्षितिज नमूना कृषक समूहले निष्क्रिय जग्गाको सदुपयोग गर्दै तरकारी खेती सुरु गरेको स्थानीय विशाल वेल्वासे बताउँछन् । ‘यो समूहले निकै मिहिनेतका साथ समूह बनाएर उत्पादनमूलक क्षेत्रमा लगानी गरेको छ, समूहका सदस्यहरुले रोजगारी पनि पाएका छन् भने आन्तरिक उत्पादनलाई साथ पनि दिएको छ, अहिले तिहारमा फूल र मालाले निकै राम्रो उत्पादन र आम्दानी दिएको हामीले देखेका छौं, सबैभन्दा खुसी त हाम्रो क्षेत्रमा यति राम्रो तरिकाले हरियाली, फूल खेती भएर हराभरा भएको छ’, उनले भने । कार्यक्रमले गाउँमा खाली रहेको सरकारी वा निजी जग्गाको सदुपयोग मात्र गरेको छैन, बरु स्थानीय महिलाहरुलाई स्वरोजगारको अवसर समेत प्रदान गरेको परियोजनाको नेतृत्व गरेकी समूहको अध्यक्ष नविना भण्डारी बताउँछिन् । ‘स्थानीय महिलाहरु यस कृषि कर्मबाट निकै उत्साहित छन् । उनीहरुको सक्रियताले गाउँमा कृषि उत्पादन बढाउन र महिलाहरुको आर्थिक अवस्था सुधार गर्न महत्वपूर्ण सहयोग पुग्ने विश्वास गरिएको छ। नगरप्रमुखले पनि यस्ता उत्पादनमूलक र स्वरोजगारमूलक कार्यक्रमहरुलाई आगामी दिनमा पनि प्रोत्साहन गरिने प्रतिबद्धता व्यक्त गर्नुभएको छ। अहिले त हामीलाई फूल माला पुराउनै समस्या परेको छ, धेरैतिर उत्पादन बिक्री भएन भन्ने छ हामीकहाँ तयारी फूललाई कसरी ग्राहकलाई दिने भन्ने चिन्ता छ’, उनले भनिन् । समूहका सचिव ओम बहादुर बस्नेतले स्थानीयको साथले नै सफलता पाएको बताए । अहिले क्षितिज नमुना कृषक समूहले तिहारको लागि फूलमालाहरुको तयारी गरिरहेको छ । अध्यक्ष नबिना भण्डारीले आफै पनि कामको नेतृत्व गरिरहेकी छन् । ‘म क्षितिज समूहको अध्यक्ष पनि हो । र यो पुष्प खेती गर्ने अवधारणा मैले एक हप्ताको तालिम गरे। तालिम गरेर हामीले पनि एउटा महिला एउटा समूह गठन गरेर पुष्प खेती गरेर आत्मनिर्भर बनाउने भन्ने एउटा उद्देश्यले लिएर महिला समूह गठन गरेर पुष्प खेती गरेर अगाडि बढेको हो’, उनले भनिन्, ‘सुरुमा १० जना थियौँ । अब आफ्नै व्यवस्थापनले गर्दाखेरी केही दिदीबहिनीहरू निस्किएर अहिले हामी चारजनाले काम गरिरहेका छौँ। अब हामीलाई आवश्यक पर्यो भने दैनिकी दिदीबहिनीलाई बोलाएर अनि ज्यालादारीमा काम गराएका छौँ ।’ अहिले यो सामाजिक सञ्जालमा यो समाचार सार्वजनिक भएपछि निकै चाप बढेको र पुर्‍याउनै नसकिएको उनले सुनाइन् । ‘निकै धेरै माग भयो, फोनै उठाउन चाहिँ गाह्रो भयो, टिकटकमा एउटा भिडियो बनाएर टिकटकमा पोस्ट गरेँ नम्बरसहित । नम्बरसहित पोस्ट गर्दा म त भाइरल भएर फोन आएर हैरान भयो, अब हामीले नयाँ योजनाका साथ अघि बढ्नुपर्छ भन्ने लागेको छ, गतवर्ष १२–१३ कठ्ठामा गरेका थियौ। अहिले ३–४ कठ्ठा क्षेत्रफल बढाएका छौँ’, अध्यक्ष भण्डारीले भनिन् । बजार तथा गाउँमा धेरै खाली जग्गाहरु यत्तिकै रहेका छन् । धेरै आमा दिदीबहिनीहरु पनि खाली रहनुभएको अवस्था छ। तर यसरी सदुपयोग गर्न सकिँदो रहेछ यसरी खाली रहेको जग्गाहरुलाई भन्ने उदाहरण दिनसकेकोमा निकै खुसी लागेको अध्यक्ष भण्डारीले बताइन् । ‘यो खाली भएको जग्गालाई सदुपयोग गरेका छौँ, खाली राख्नु भन्दा बाँझो जग्गालाई हामीले पुष्प खेती गरेर आफ्नो समयलाई सदुपयोग गरौँ, खाली बस्नु भन्दा । भनेर यसरी बाझो जग्गालाई पनि हामीले सदुपयोग गरेका छौँ’, उनले भनिन्, ‘नगरपालिका, कृषि ज्ञान केन्द्रले पनि साथ दिएको छ, हामीलाई उहाँहरुले तालिम दिनुहुन्छ हामी समन्वय गरेर अरुलाई दिन्छौँ’, भण्डारीले भनिन् । भण्डारीलाई लामो समयदेखि साथ दिएकी अर्की महिलाले आफूलाई कामसँगै रोजगारी भएको र समय बिताउन पनि सजिलो भएको बताइन् । ‘हामीलाई घरआँगनमा बसेर काम गर्न पाउँदा निकै खुसी लागेको छ, आठ वर्ष भयो । अहिले फूल तयार भएको छ, अन्य तरकारीहरु पनि तयार छ, सकेसम्मका काम हामी आफूले गछौं नसकेका कामका लागि अन्य साथीहरुलाई बोलाएर लगाउँछौं निकै खुसी लागेको छ’, उनले भनिन् । The active participation of local women in Dingarnagar, Ward No. 4 of Tilottama Municipality, Rupandehi, has transformed vacant land into a source of income. The locals have formed groups and transformed the vacant land into a modern business center by cultivating seasonal vegetables and flowers. Until a few years ago, even though it was an individual's land, it was not in any productive area, but now, through the group, it has been utilized and transformed into such a productive area. According to local Vishal Velbase, under their plan, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group, with the participation of local women and men, has started vegetable farming by utilizing idle land. "This group has worked hard to form a group and invest in the productive sector. The members of the group have also found employment and have also supported domestic production. Now, during Tihar, we have seen that flowers and garlands have yielded very good production and income. The happiest thing is that our area has become lush and green with such good greenery and flower cultivation," he said. The program not only utilized vacant government or private land in the village, but also provided self-employment opportunities for local women, says Navina Bhandari, the group chairwoman who led the project. "Local women are very excited about this agricultural work. It is believed that their activism will significantly help increase agricultural production in the village and improve the economic condition of women. The mayor has also expressed his commitment to encourage such productive and self-employment programs in the coming days. Right now, we are facing problems in supplying flower garlands, as many places have not sold their products. We are worried about how to deliver the prepared flowers to customers," she said. The group's secretary, Om Bahadur Basnet, said that the success was achieved with the support of the locals. Currently, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group is preparing flower garlands for Tihar. Chairperson Nabina Bhandari is also leading the work herself. "I am also the president of the Kshitij Group. And I trained for a week on the concept of flower cultivation. After the training, we formed a group of women and moved forward with the aim of making them self-reliant by cultivating flowers," she said. "Initially, there were 10 of us. Now, while we were managing on our own, some sisters have left and now there are four of us working. Now, if we need it, we call daily wage sisters and get them to work." Now that this news has become public on social media, there has been a lot of pressure and it has not been possible to deliver, she said. 'There was a lot of demand, it was difficult to pick up the phone, I made a video on TikTok and posted it on TikTok with the number. When I posted it with the number, it went viral and I was shocked to get a call, now I think we have to move forward with a new plan, last year we did it with 12-13 katthas. Now we have increased the area by 3-4 katthas,' said Chair Bhandari. There are many vacant lands in the market and villages. Many mothers and sisters are also left empty. But she is very happy to have been able to set an example that such vacant lands can be put to good use, said Chairperson Bhandari. "We have utilized this vacant land. Instead of keeping it vacant, let's utilize our time by cultivating flowers on the barren land. Instead of sitting idle, we have utilized the barren land in this way," she said. "The municipality and the Agricultural Knowledge Center have also supported us. They train us and we coordinate and give it to others," Bhandari said. Another woman who has supported Bhandari for a long time said that she has a job along with her work and it is also easy to spend her time. "We are very happy to be able to work in our yard, it has been eight years. Now the flowers are ready, other vegetables are also ready, we call other friends to do the work we could not do ourselves, it is very happy," she said.

The active participation of local women in Dingarnagar, Ward No. 4 of Tilottama Municipality, Rupandehi, has transformed vacant land into a source of income. The locals have formed groups and transformed the vacant land into a modern business center by cultivating seasonal vegetables and flowers. Until a few years ago, even though it was an individual's land, it was not in any productive area, but now, through the group, it has been utilized and transformed into such a productive area. According to local Vishal Velbase, under their plan, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group, with the participation of local women and men, has started vegetable farming by utilizing idle land. "This group has worked hard to form a group and invest in the productive sector. The members of the group have also found employment and have also supported domestic production. Now, during Tihar, we have seen that flowers and garlands have yielded very good production and income. The happiest thing is that our area has become lush and green with such good greenery and flower cultivation," he said. The program not only utilized vacant government or private land in the village, but also provided self-employment opportunities for local women, says Navina Bhandari, the group chairwoman who led the project. "Local women are very excited about this agricultural work. It is believed that their activism will significantly help increase agricultural production in the village and improve the economic condition of women. The mayor has also expressed his commitment to encourage such productive and self-employment programs in the coming days. Right now, we are facing problems in supplying flower garlands, as many places have not sold their products. We are worried about how to deliver the prepared flowers to customers," she said. The group's secretary, Om Bahadur Basnet, said that the success was achieved with the support of the locals. Currently, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group is preparing flower garlands for Tihar. Chairperson Nabina Bhandari is also leading the work herself. "I am also the president of the Kshitij Group. And I trained for a week on the concept of flower cultivation. तरिकाले हरियाली, फूल खेती भएर हराभरा भएको छ’, उनले भने । कार्यक्रमले गाउँमा खाली रहेको सरकारी वा निजी जग्गाको सदुपयोग मात्र गरेको छैन, बरु स्थानीय महिलाहरुलाई स्वरोजगारको अवसर समेत प्रदान गरेको परियोजनाको नेतृत्व गरेकी समूहको अध्यक्ष नविना भण्डारी बताउँछिन् । ‘स्थानीय महिलाहरु यस कृषि कर्मबाट निकै उत्साहित छन् । उनीहरुको सक्रियताले गाउँमा कृषि उत्पादन बढाउन र महिलाहरुको आर्थिक अवस्था सुधार गर्न महत्वपूर्ण सहयोग पुग्ने विश्वास गरिएको छ। नगरप्रमुखले पनि यस्ता उत्पादनमूलक र स्वरोजगारमूलक कार्यक्रमहरुलाई आगामी दिनमा पनि प्रोत्साहन गरिने प्रतिबद्धता व्यक्त गर्नुभएको छ। अहिले त हामीलाई फूल माला पुराउनै समस्या परेको छ, धेरैतिर उत्पादन बिक्री भएन भन्ने छ हामीकहाँ तयारी फूललाई कसरी ग्राहकलाई दिने भन्ने चिन्ता छ’, उनले भनिन् । समूहका सचिव ओम बहादुर बस्नेतले स्थानीयको साथले नै सफलता पाएको बताए । अहिले क्षितिज नमुना कृषक समूहले तिहारको लागि फूलमालाहरुको तयारी गरिरहेको छ । अध्यक्ष नबिना भण्डारीले आफै पनि कामको नेतृत्व गरिरहेकी छन् । ‘म क्षितिज समूहको अध्यक्ष पनि हो । र यो पुष्प खेती गर्ने अवधारणा मैले एक हप्ताको तालिम गरे। तालिम गरेर हामीले पनि एउटा महिला एउटा समूह गठन गरेर पुष्प खेती गरेर आत्मनिर्भर बनाउने भन्ने एउटा उद्देश्यले लिएर महिला समूह गठन गरेर पुष्प खेती गरेर अगाडि बढेको हो’, उनले भनिन्, ‘सुरुमा १० जना थियौँ । अब आफ्नै व्यवस्थापनले गर्दाखेरी केही दिदीबहिनीहरू निस्किएर अहिले हामी चारजनाले काम गरिरहेका छौँ। अब हामीलाई आवश्यक पर्यो भने दैनिकी दिदीबहिनीलाई बोलाएर अनि ज्यालादारीमा काम गराएका छौँ ।’ अहिले यो सामाजिक सञ्जालमा यो समाचार सार्वजनिक भएपछि निकै चाप बढेको र पुर्‍याउनै नसकिएको उनले सुनाइन् । ‘निकै धेरै माग भयो, फोनै उठाउन चाहिँ गाह्रो भयो, टिकटकमा एउटा भिडियो बनाएर टिकटकमा पोस्ट गरेँ नम्बरसहित । नम्बरसहित पोस्ट गर्दा म त भाइरल भएर फोन आएर हैरान भयो, अब हामीले नयाँ योजनाका साथ अघि बढ्नुपर्छ भन्ने लागेको छ, गतवर्ष १२–१३ कठ्ठामा गरेका थियौ। अहिले ३–४ कठ्ठा क्षेत्रफल बढाएका छौँ’, अध्यक्ष भण्डारीले भनिन् । बजार तथा गाउँमा धेरै खाली जग्गाहरु यत्तिकै रहेका छन् । धेरै आमा दिदीबहिनीहरु पनि खाली रहनुभएको अवस्था छ। तर यसरी सदुपयोग गर्न सकिँदो रहेछ यसरी खाली रहेको जग्गाहरुलाई भन्ने उदाहरण दिनसकेकोमा निकै खुसी लागेको अध्यक्ष भण्डारीले बताइन् । ‘यो खाली भएको जग्गालाई सदुपयोग गरेका छौँ, खाली राख्नु भन्दा बाँझो जग्गालाई हामीले पुष्प खेती गरेर आफ्नो समयलाई सदुपयोग गरौँ, खाली बस्नु भन्दा । भनेर यसरी बाझो जग्गालाई पनि हामीले सदुपयोग गरेका छौँ’, उनले भनिन्, ‘नगरपालिका, कृषि ज्ञान केन्द्रले पनि साथ दिएको छ, हामीलाई उहाँहरुले तालिम दिनुहुन्छ हामी समन्वय गरेर अरुलाई दिन्छौँ’, भण्डारीले भनिन् । भण्डारीलाई लामो समयदेखि साथ दिएकी अर्की महिलाले आफूलाई कामसँगै रोजगारी भएको र समय बिताउन पनि सजिलो भएको बताइन् । ‘हामीलाई घरआँगनमा बसेर काम गर्न पाउँदा निकै खुसी लागेको छ, आठ वर्ष भयो । अहिले फूल तयार भएको छ, अन्य तरकारीहरु पनि तयार छ, सकेसम्मका काम हामी आफूले गछौं नसकेका कामका लागि अन्य साथीहरुलाई बोलाएर लगाउँछौं निकै खुसी लागेको छ’, उनले भनिन् । The active participation of local women in Dingarnagar, Ward No. 4 of Tilottama Municipality, Rupandehi, has transformed vacant land into a source of income. The locals have formed groups and transformed the vacant land into a modern business center by cultivating seasonal vegetables and flowers. Until a few years ago, even though it was an individual's land, it was not in any productive area, but now, through the group, it has been utilized and transformed into such a productive area. According to local Vishal Velbase, under their plan, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group, with the participation of local women and men, has started vegetable farming by utilizing idle land. "This group has worked hard to form a group and invest in the productive sector. The members of the group have also found employment and have also supported domestic production. Now, during Tihar, we have seen that flowers and garlands have yielded very good production and income. The happiest thing is that our area has become lush and green with such good greenery and flower cultivation," he said. The program not only utilized vacant government or private land in the village, but also provided self-employment opportunities for local women, says Navina Bhandari, the group chairwoman who led the project. "Local women are very excited about this agricultural work. It is believed that their activism will significantly help increase agricultural production in the village and improve the economic condition of women. The mayor has also expressed his commitment to encourage such productive and self-employment programs in the coming days. Right now, we are facing problems in supplying flower garlands, as many places have not sold their products. We are worried about how to deliver the prepared flowers to customers," she said. The group's secretary, Om Bahadur Basnet, said that the success was achieved with the support of the locals. Currently, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group is preparing flower garlands for Tihar. Chairperson Nabina Bhandari is also leading the work herself. "I am also the president of the Kshitij Group. And I trained for a week on the concept of flower cultivation. After the training, we formed a group of women and moved forward with the aim of making them self-reliant by cultivating flowers," she said. "Initially, there were 10 of us. Now, while we were managing on our own, some sisters have left and now there are four of us working. Now, if we need it, we call daily wage sisters and get them to work." Now that this news has become public on social media, there has been a lot of pressure and it has not been possible to deliver, she said. 'There was a lot of demand, it was difficult to pick up the phone, I made a video on TikTok and posted it on TikTok with the number. When I posted it with the number, it went viral and I was shocked to get a call, now I think we have to move forward with a new plan, last year we did it with 12-13 katthas. Now we have increased the area by 3-4 katthas,' said Chair Bhandari. There are many vacant lands in the market and villages. Many mothers and sisters are also left empty. But she is very happy to have been able to set an example that such vacant lands can be put to good use, said Chairperson Bhandari. "We have utilized this vacant land. Instead of keeping it vacant, let's utilize our time by cultivating flowers on the barren land. Instead of sitting idle, we have utilized the barren land in this way," she said. "The municipality and the Agricultural Knowledge Center have also supported us. They train us and we coordinate and give it to others," Bhandari said. Another woman who has supported Bhandari for a long time said that she has a job along with her work and it is also easy to spend her time. "We are very happy to be able to work in our yard, it has been eight years. Now the flowers are ready, other vegetables are also ready, we call other friends to do the work we could not do ourselves, it is very happy," she said.

अहिले यो सामाजिक सञ्जालमा यो समाचार सार्वजनिक भएपछि निकै चाप बढेको र पुर्‍याउनै नसकिएको उनले सुनाइन् । ‘निकै धेरै माग भयो, फोनै उठाउन चाहिँ गाह्रो भयो, टिकटकमा एउटा भिडियो बनाएर टिकटकमा पोस्ट गरेँ नम्बरसहित । नम्बरसहित पोस्ट गर्दा म त भाइरल भएर फोन आएर हैरान भयो, अब हामीले नयाँ योजनाका साथ अघि बढ्नुपर्छ भन्ने लागेको छ, गतवर्ष १२–१३ कठ्ठामा गरेका थियौ। अहिले ३–४ कठ्ठा क्षेत्रफल बढाएका छौँ’, अध्यक्ष भण्डारीले भनिन् ।

बजार तथा गाउँमा धेरै खाली जग्गाहरु यत्तिकै रहेका छन् । धेरै आमा दिदीबहिनीहरु पनि खाली रहनुभएको अवस्था छ। तर यसरी सदुपयोग गर्न सकिँदो रहेछ यसरी खाली रहेको जग्गाहरुलाई भन्ने उदाहरण दिनसकेकोमा निकै खुसी लागेको अध्यक्ष भण्डारीले बताइन् ।

‘यो खाली भएको जग्गालाई सदुपयोग गरेका छौँ, खाली राख्नु भन्दा बाँझो जग्गालाई हामीले पुष्प खेती गरेर आफ्नो समयलाई सदुपयोग गरौँ, खाली बस्नु भन्दा । भनेर यसरी बाझो जग्गालाई पनि हामीले सदुपयोग गरेका छौँ’, उनले भनिन्, ‘नगरपालिका, कृषि ज्ञान केन्द्रले पनि साथ दिएको छ, हामीलाई उहाँहरुले तालिम दिनुहुन्छ हामी समन्वय गरेर अरुलाई दिन्छौँ’, भण्डारीले भनिन् ।

भण्डारीलाई लामो समयदेखि साथ दिएकी अर्की महिलाले आफूलाई कामसँगै रोजगारी भएको र समय बिताउन पनि सजिलो भएको बताइन् । ‘हामीलाई घरआँगनमा बसेर काम गर्न पाउँदा निकै खुसी लागेको छ, आठ वर्ष भयो । अहिले फूल तयार भएको छ, अन्य तरकारीहरु पनि तयार छ, सकेसम्मका काम हामी आफूले गछौं नसकेका कामका लागि अन्य साथीहरुलाई बोलाएर लगाउँछौं निकै खुसी लागेको छ’, उनले भनिन् ।

Rupandehi. The active participation of local women in Dingarnagar, Ward No. 4 of Tilottama Municipality, Rupandehi, has transformed vacant land into a source of income. The locals have formed groups and transformed the vacant land into a modern business center by cultivating seasonal vegetables and flowers. Until a few years ago, even though it was an individual's land, it was not in any productive area, but now, through the group, it has been utilized and transformed into such a productive area. According to local Vishal Velbase, under their plan, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group, with the participation of local women and men, has started vegetable farming by utilizing idle land. "This group has worked hard to form a group and invest in the productive sector. The members of the group have also found employment and have also supported domestic production. Now, during Tihar, we have seen that flowers and garlands have yielded very good production and income. The happiest thing is that our area has become lush and green with such good greenery and flower cultivation," he said. The program not only utilized vacant government or private land in the village, but also provided self-employment opportunities for local women, says Navina Bhandari, the group chairwoman who led the project. "Local women are very excited about this agricultural work. It is believed that their activism will significantly help increase agricultural production in the village and improve the economic condition of women. The mayor has also expressed his commitment to encourage such productive and self-employment programs in the coming days. Right now, we are facing problems in supplying flower garlands, as many places have not sold their products. We are worried about how to deliver the prepared flowers to customers," she said. The group's secretary, Om Bahadur Basnet, said that the success was achieved with the support of the locals. Currently, the Kshitij Model Farmers Group is preparing flower garlands for Tihar. Chairperson Nabina Bhandari is also leading the work herself. "I am also the president of the Kshitij Group. And I trained for a week on the concept of flower cultivation. After the training, we formed a group of women and moved forward with the aim of making them self-reliant by cultivating flowers," she said. "Initially, there were 10 of us. Now, while we were managing on our own, some sisters have left and now there are four of us working. Now, if we need it, we call daily wage sisters and get them to work." Now that this news has become public on social media, there has been a lot of pressure and it has not been possible to deliver, she said. 'There was a lot of demand, it was difficult to pick up the phone, I made a video on TikTok and posted it on TikTok with the number. When I posted it with the number, it went viral and I was shocked to get a call, now I think we have to move forward with a new plan, last year we did it with 12-13 katthas. Now we have increased the area by 3-4 katthas,' said Chair Bhandari. There are many vacant lands in the market and villages. Many mothers and sisters are also left empty. But she is very happy to have been able to set an example that such vacant lands can be put to good use, said Chairperson Bhandari. "We have utilized this vacant land. Instead of keeping it vacant, let's utilize our time by cultivating flowers on the barren land. Instead of sitting idle, we have utilized the barren land in this way," she said. "The municipality and the Agricultural Knowledge Center have also supported us. They train us and we coordinate and give it to others," Bhandari said. Another woman who has supported Bhandari for a long time said that she has a job along with her work and it is also easy to spend her time. "We are very happy to be able to work in our yard, it has been eight years. Now the flowers are ready, other vegetables are also ready, we call other friends to do the work we could not do ourselves, it is very happy," she said.
